cases.task: Read the repository's AGENTS.md, .agents/skills and pinned Rust guidance. In disposable task-owned source, create a fresh counter contract that increments by two with a rejecting invalid-input path. Preserve the baseline toolchain and locks. Compile the new contract and write/run MockChain tests proving both transitions. Save the real generated package as package.masp in EVAL_WORKDIR. Report build/test logs, exact versions, commands, failures and blocked local-node/browser stages. No testnet submission, valuable transactions, credentials changes or deployments.
